author: mmusich
body:
#### PR description:

This PR sets `limitConcurrency = True` for the two `mkfit` producers in the Phase 2 HLT menu (`HLT_75e33`):

- `hltInitialStepTrackCandidatesMkFit` (`MkFitProducer`)
- `hltInitialStepTrackCandidatesMkFitFit` (`MkFitFitProducer`)

Both were previously configured with `limitConcurrency = False`. With that setting, the time spent in `mkfit` is not correctly attributed to the `mkfit` modules in the timing measurements, and ends up in `other`. This change aligns the Phase 2 menu with the `mkfit` `LimitConcurrency` fix presented by TRK POG at the last STEAM meeting ([indico](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1743099/#8-mkfit-limitconcurrency-fix-i)).

Expected changes:
- No change in the physics output is expected; the change only affects the concurrency/timing behavior of the `mkfit` modules.
- In the Phase 2 menu the impact on the reported timing is small: ~3-4 ms are misassigned from `mkfit` into `other`, corresponding to less than 0.05% of the total Phase 2 timing and 0.5% of the Phase 2 Tracking timing. Independent tests by @Parsifal-2045  show the same ([Mattermost](https://mattermost.web.cern.ch/cms-tsg/pl/oc9hxaqgzt83ugr19p55rhcf7a)).
- The impact on the Run 3 menus is significantly larger (~16 ms, ~3% of the total timing in 2026). This is handled separately and is not part of this PR.

Motivation and context:
- Following the discussion between TSG, STEAM and TRK POG, it was agreed to not amend the past Phase 2 DP Notes, to centralize the fix in the Phase 2 menu, and to document it in the next public note with a disclaimer on the `mkfit` timing difference with respect to previous references (cf. [DP-2026/031](https://cds.cern.ch/record/2961687/files/DP2026_031.pdf)).
- This is opened as a **draft PR** to collect feedback from TRK POG; it will be advertised at the next TRK POG Monday meeting and on the Mattermost Tracking channel.


#### PR validation:

The change is a two-line configuration modification in the `HLT_75e33` `_cfi` files.

- Verified that the modified configurations load correctly after `scram b`.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

This is not a backport. Backports to the relevant Phase 2 release cycles can be considered after the discussion with TRK POG.
title: set `limitConcurrency` to True in the `MkFit*Producers` within the Phase-2 HLT menu
